title: Scale uses
description: Three uses of a scheme's key scale in the light theme, each a text on a fill, with the WCAG contrast computed from the built colors. Drawn by the ScaleUses composite on How the scale is built.

hue.description: The hue of the key scale, such as pink or blue.

uses.description: Each use: the main button, a highlight and a banner.

use.description: What the pair is used for.

sample.description: The words drawn in the use, from the scheme's samples.

fill.description: The fill: a step of the key scale.

step.description: The step of the scale, 50 to 950.

hex.description: The color as built, in uppercase hex.

text.description: The text color: a step of the key scale, or the scheme's text on its action.

step.description: The step of the scale, 50 to 950.

token.description: The semantic token of the text, when it is not a step, such as text.on-action.

hex.description: The color as built, in uppercase hex.

contrast.description: The WCAG contrast ratio of the text on the fill, to two decimals.

level.description: The WCAG level for body text: AAA from 7, AA from 4.5, AA-large (large text only) from 3, else fail.
